cases.name: Kathleen Dawn West
cases.about: She was an adult model who ran a subscription-only website.
cases.narrative: He beat her to death with an Absinthe bottle AND left her partially clothed on the ground outside her home. Her head was in the street and her body was in the grass. She had a 2-inch gash in her forehead and a fractured skull.
